data.name: Broken Orbits
data.detailed_description:
The stars were divided by design.

The Ancients scattered humanity. One crew can reunite it.

Find the home world. End the Ancient threat.

Broken Orbits is a fast-paced top-down space-combat campaign for one to four players. Boost through dense fleet battles, evade missile swarms, tear apart capital ships, and breach massive rotating fortresses as the screen fills with weapons, enemies, and environmental chaos.

Every successful mission can transform your build. Loot new weapons and rare prototype effects, unlock two specialized upgrade branches for each weapon, and combine six combat systems into a ship that fights exactly the way you want.

Flood space with seeker swarms. Pierce formations with rail lances. Chain electricity between ships, detonate gravity mines, disrupt entire fleets with EMP weapons, or launch armored torpedoes into fortress cores. In co-op, combine different loadouts to overwhelm enemies in ways no single ship could manage alone.

Fight through a complete three-chapter storyline that begins with dangerous salvage work and escalates into a war against the Ancients, the machine civilization responsible for destroying every society powerful enough to challenge it.

Win missions, extract powerful technology, expand your arsenal, strengthen your base, and build the crew capable of finishing the war.

Fight fast. Loot something strange. Come back stronger.
